title_lines: During the year 2023, the Company acquired call center operations and telemedicine setup (the business segment) of Hello Doctor Private Limited via “Business
Intemational Financial Reporting Standard 3 (IFRS 3) “Business Combinations”, fequires that all identified assets and liabilities acquired in a business combination
should be carried at fair values in the acquirer’s balance sheet and any intangible assets acquired in the business combination are required to be separately
recognized and carried at fair values. However, IFRS 3 also allows the acquirer a maximum of one year from the date of acquisition to finalize the accounting of
In 2023, since valuation exercise was not completed, the company recognized the assets acquired at their fair value and the difference between the consideration
transferred and the fair value of identifiable assets was recognized as goodwill amounting to Rs 78.205 million on the basis of provisional valuation.
